_doc: Overlay timeline for the final cut (absolute seconds; frame f shows time f/24).
Resolved by comp/overlays.py into a per-frame timeline (word refs -> exact word times from timing/shots.json,
tracker JSON -> smoothed screen paths) and rendered by comp/overlay/overlay.js in headless Chromium.
Word refs: {"shot": .., "word": .., "nth": k} = start time of the k-th occurrence of that word in that shot,
minus 'lead' seconds (the eye leads the ear by ~1-2 frames). Any time may instead be a number (absolute s).
Keyword 'out' = the moment the short exit (0.25-0.3 s) has fully finished. overlays.py --resolve checks every key word:
settled hold (all letters legible) >= 0.8 s, exit only after the last word has been spoken, gone by the cut (+2 frames)
unless a 'carry' reason is given, one key word in the band at a time, ink inside the safe area (rendered extents).
Callout 'sync' = the moment the anchor dot lands (UI tick in the sound mix); 'out' = fully gone. Callout options:
'leader' (px), 'follow' (fraction of the anchor motion the label follows), 'clamp' (anchor glides to a stop this many
px inside the safe area instead of fading), 'enabled'. Trackers come from comp/tracks/<shot>.json (export_tracks
format); 'fallback' is used when that file / tracker is missing (static [x, y] or keys [[t, x, y], ...]).
Safe area (BRIEF §3/§5): key words in band y 520-820, nothing below y 1498 (bottom 22%), x > 950 (right 12%)

widgets._doc: corner monitor; R peaks locked to the mix's heartbeat (S1 anchor 31.42 s, 72 bpm, R = S1 - 0.03 s)
free-standing live count (TRK_cells is on screen only 54.4-56.1 s), log-accelerating from 1 cell to ~37 trillion during the pull-back, landing on the tick; sits below the key-word band
sun -> sea -> cloud -> rain -> river -> forest drawn on in sequence ('bütün bu ihtiyaçların karşılanması'), then on 'bir tek' every line bends upward and converges into one point of light (the sun)

one ring per living thing: a-c on the mix's ticks (birer, birer, görüp), then d-h accelerating to 'gözetip'+ while every subject is still in frame (rings fade before their subject leaves the safe area); the seedling ring hands over to the dew drop and lingers

then._doc: hand-over to the dew drop at the leaf tip where the camera comes to rest (measured on the sh13b animatic f2110-2120; the studio should export TRK_dew)

widgets._doc: Vogel phyllotaxis (theta = n*137.508 deg, r = c*sqrt(n)); parastichy families 21 and 34 drawn on from the centre on 'hikmetli'. Scale = k_px_m / depth (k = focal_px * c = 5333 px * 0.078/sqrt(1550) m); optional exact matchmove from tracks/sh14a_disc.json
widgets._doc2: both families drawn by 90.4 s; the pattern lives while the florets are >= 8-16 px apart on screen, i.e. well into the pull-back; numerals sit below the head, out of the key-word band
